name: Polyhedra Network
rootCause: Polyhedra was exploited due to the compromise of the private keys, which resulted in a loss of 1,400,323 THENA tokens worth approximately $760,000. The contract was maliciously upgraded following the leakage of the private key of the administrator account. The exploiter swapped all of the stolen assets for 1,299 BNB tokens. According to the team, the incident resulted from intentional theft rather than a vulnerability in the contract itself.

descriptions.text: Polyhedra was exploited due to the compromise of the private keys, which resulted in a loss of 1,400,323 THENA tokens worth approximately $760,000. The contract was maliciously upgraded following the leakage of the private key of the administrator account. The exploiter swapped all of the stolen assets for 1,299 BNB tokens. According to the team, the incident resulted from intentional theft rather than a vulnerability in the contract itself.

Polyhedra Network suffered a March 12, 2024 key-compromise incident on BNB Chain. Public catalogs record about $760,000 in losses, while later reports describe a larger wallet withdrawal and token sale that the available record does not reconcile. A Polyhedra-controlled wallet key or equivalent signing credential on BNB Chain was compromised, allowing unauthorized transfers. The public record does not identify the exact compromise path or the specific wallet involved.
